rows.en: ＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿００８Oh good, you're home! I suddenly￥felt like dropping by! Sorry for￥showing up out of nowhere.
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿００９Cousin, you've been doing￥amazing lately!
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１０Aha! I bet you've been doing￥secret training, haven't you?
Yeah, secret training.
No, nothing like that.
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１１Ohh, so that's it!￥You always work so hard, Cousin!￥I should follow your example!
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１２What? If you haven't been￥training, that's even more￥amazing!
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１３Losing to you without any extra￥training? That's so humiliating!￥It's meant to be my specialty!
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１４I'm really proud to be related￥to someone like you, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１５So, Cousin! Next time, teach me￥your secret for boosting your￥scores, okay?
Sure, but I'm strict!
Figure it out yourself.
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１６Aww, that's mean!￥For your adorable cousin's sake,￥please go easy on me, okay?
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１７Whaaat?! Come on!￥Would it kill you to teach me￥just a little?
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１８If you're gonna be mean to me,￥I'll tell everyone embarrassing￥stories about you as a kid!
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０１９Just kidding! I wouldn't really.
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０２０I've been kind of slacking,￥haven't I?
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０２１Only after you passed me did I￥realize how hard you'd been￥working, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１３８＿０２２But I think I can still￥make up for it!＝＠１３８＿０２３So for the next exam,￥I'm gonna try even harder!
